experiment_name: Meno-J Experiment 10: Calibration Onboarding and Compatibility Bridge

prerequisites.feature_checkpoints: Reuse all 15 hash-validated Experiment 9 feature checkpoints without re-extracting raw WESAD signals.

research_questions: How does coverage and prediction-set informativeness change as a previously unseen WESAD subject supplies limited labeled calibration windows?
Can unlabeled physiological compatibility identify external calibration subjects that serve a held-out subject better than dissimilar calibration subjects?
Do S2 and S4 recover under personal calibration, or remain difficult after calibration mismatch is reduced?

fold_contract.classifier: The Experiment 9 NumPy regularized LDA, fit only on the 10 training subjects.
fold_contract.personal_test_set: Fifteen label-stratified, deterministic held-out windows per subject and repetition; never used for compatibility estimation or calibration.
fold_contract.onboarding_pool: All remaining held-out-subject windows. Labels are hidden from compatibility estimation and used only when a window enters a personal calibration schedule.

personal_calibration_schedule.small_sample_rule: At alpha=0.1, fewer than nine personal scores cannot produce a finite split-conformal threshold. The honest personal-only result is therefore an infinite threshold and a full three-label prediction set; it must not be described as an informative repair.

compatibility_contract.personal_information_used: Unlabeled features from the held-out subject onboarding pool only.
compatibility_contract.representation: Feature vectors standardized using training-subject mean and scale; each subject represented by its standardized onboarding centroid.
compatibility_contract.distance: Euclidean centroid distance divided by square root of feature count.
compatibility_contract.external_nearest2: The two external calibration subjects with smallest compatibility distance.
compatibility_contract.external_farthest2: The two external calibration subjects with largest compatibility distance; negative control.

decision_rules.general_personal_repair: At k=12 versus external_all4, mean subject coverage increases by at least 0.05, worst-subject coverage increases by at least 0.10, and mean full-set frequency increases by no more than 0.20.
decision_rules.s2_s4_personal_repair: For both S2 and S4, k=12 coverage increases by at least 0.10, reaches at least 0.80, and full-set frequency increases by no more than 0.20 versus external_all4.
decision_rules.compatibility_support: external_nearest2 improves mean robustness loss by at least 0.03 versus external_farthest2, where loss is absolute deviation from 0.90 coverage plus 0.25 times full-set frequency.
decision_rules.persistent_difficulty: S2 or S4 remains below 0.80 mean coverage at k=12 with a finite threshold, or gains coverage only with a full-set-frequency increase above 0.20.

interpretation_guardrails: S2 and S4 were selected after Experiment 9 and are exploratory case studies, not an independent confirmation cohort.
Personal calibration changes the uncertainty threshold but does not retrain or personalize the classifier.
Compatibility associations are not causal physiological explanations.
No claim of literature novelty is made without a separate validated literature review.
Coverage improvements must be interpreted jointly with prediction-set informativeness.
